title: Choose your best piece of work to date
why_matters: Two weeks before your probation review, you need to start curating. Not everything you've done is portfolio-worthy. Pick the one piece — out of everything between weeks 1 and 12 — that best shows the kind of analyst you're becoming. Picking is a skill; this exercise is the dress rehearsal for many years of choosing.
steps: Open your evidence file. Read every entry.
Score each piece on three axes: was the outcome good, was the work specifically yours, would you be proud of someone else doing exactly this?
Pick the top one. Allow second-place to inform your evidence portfolio later — but commit to one piece first.
Write a single line at the top of the file: "the piece of work that best shows what I do is X, because Y".
success_criteria: One specific piece of work is identified as your strongest. Your evidence file has the single-line statement at the top. You can defend the choice in one sentence to your line manager.
reflection_prompt: What did you almost pick instead, and why didn't you?
